mapper.select: select r.data_scope from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id=r.id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.deleted=0 and r.enabled=1
select count(*) from pr_requisition r where r.id=#{id} and r.deleted=0 and ${scope}
select count(*) from po_purchase_order o join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id where o.id=#{id} and o.deleted=0 and ${scope}
select id,parent_id from sys_department where deleted=0
